title: ClientMessage
description: One JSON (text) message a client sends on the voice socket GET /v1/sessions/{session_id}/voice, discriminated by type. Binary messages are not JSON: while a capture is active each binary message is one chunk of audio in the format of capture.start. A message the schema does not describe, or an unknown type, is answered with an error event and changes nothing. There is deliberately no message that confirms, rejects or chooses: speech never confirms an action (a confirmation is the structured input of POST /v1/sessions/{session_id}/turns), and nothing here can widen the scope the context token gave the connection.

captureStart.description: Start streaming audio. The binary messages that follow are the audio, until capture.end or capture.cancel. A capture that starts while speech is playing cancels the playback at once (barge-in).

captureEnd.description: No more audio follows: the transcript is finalised and enters the turn pipeline.

captureCancel.description: Discard the capture in progress: nothing is transcribed into a turn and nothing is kept.

audioSubmit.description: Submit one finalised utterance as a single message instead of streaming it. A submission that starts while speech is playing cancels the playback at once (barge-in).

audio.description: The whole utterance, raw PCM in format, base64 encoded (at most 8 MiB of audio).

playbackCancel.description: Stop the speech that is playing now. Synthesis is cancelled at once and no further audio is sent.

transcriptCorrect.description: Replace the transcript of the latest utterance with corrected text, before any consequential confirmation. The corrected text runs through the same turn pipeline on the same session as a new message; a preparation made from the old transcript is voided by the pipeline's own correction rules and cannot be confirmed. A correction after a newer utterance is refused (stale).
